name: Dead Tide V: The One Eyed Terror
source:
The Dread Pirate Queen Jessenia and her flesh challenged sidekick Gibonotik must go ashore to provision their ship, the "Black Pearl Necklace." Taking some redshirts along for protection, they encounter Polypenis, the One Eyed Terror, whereupon Jessenia deals with the predicament in her usual fashion. Meanwhile, the stalwart warrior Gazukull and his dark elf companion Alia D'Vir are in hot pursuit of Jessenia and her crew for reasons as yet unknown, which also leads them to encounter the dreaded Polypenis…

[From [url=https://affect3dstore.com/dead-tide-5-the-one-eyed-terror.html]Affect3D[/url]]
translation:
恐怖海盗女王杰塞尼娅和她那位肉体残缺的助手吉博诺蒂克必须上岸，为自己的船“黑珍珠项链”补充物资。他们带上几名红衫兵护卫，却遇到了独眼恐怖波吕佩尼斯，杰塞尼娅便用一贯的方式处理这场危机。与此同时，坚毅的战士加祖库尔和他的黑暗精灵同伴阿莉娅·德维尔正因未知原因紧追杰塞尼娅一行，这也让他们撞上了可怕的波吕佩尼斯……

[来自[url=https://affect3dstore.com/dead-tide-5-the-one-eyed-terror.html]Affect3D[/url]]
